name.en: True Dao of the Black Tortoise

description.zh:
◆ 武斗中攻击力和防御力提升5%

◆ 武斗中生命和真气上限提升10%
description.en:
◆ +5% Attack and Defense in Combat



◆ +10% Max HP and Max Qi in Combat

description2.zh: 施展乾坤挪移之术，接下来短回合数内会将受到的部分伤害返还给攻击者，同时提升反击概率且不限制反击次数。
description2.en: Cast the art of Universe Shift. For a brief number of turns, reflects a portion of damage taken back to attackers, while increasing Counter Chance and removing the limit on Counterattack Count.

description2.zh: 习武之人崇尚的四兽口诀之一，武艺高超者更是能唤出青龙之气。短时间内增加自身攻击力与暴击率。
description2.en: One of the Four Beast mantras revered by martial artists, true masters can even summon the Qi of the Azure Dragon. Briefly increases Attack and Crit.

description2.zh: 特殊的身法技能，可以瞬间靠近或远离目标，并恢复少量真气值。移动距离比普通的翻滚更远。
description2.en: A special movement skill that can instantly close in on or move away from the target and recover a small amount of Qi. Its Move Distance is greater than a standard roll.

description2.zh: 枪系绝学，若使用得当则杀伤力惊人。本次攻击将大幅提升暴击率，且会对敌人造成流血效果。
description2.en: A spear art of devastating power when used properly. This attack greatly increases Crit and inflicts Bleed on the enemy.

description2.zh: 长枪绝学之一，以三段突为基础的进阶招式，快速突刺后以致命一击终结敌人。使敌人下回合降低防御力，并无法移动。
description2.en: One of the spear secret arts, an advanced technique based on Triple Thrust that delivers rapid thrusts before finishing the enemy with a lethal blow. Reduces enemy Defense and immobilizes them next turn.

description2.zh: 剑系传奇绝学，将部分剑气融入躯体用于御敌，再将剩余的剑气打出，对敌人造成海量伤害。
description2.en: A legendary Sword art. Infuse part of your sword Qi into your body for defense, then unleash the rest to deal massive damage to the enemy.

description2.zh: 早已失传的弓系绝学，将大量的寒气融入箭身后射向敌人，犹如冰龙穿心，对敌人造成大量伤害，并附加寒霜与破势效果。
description2.en: A long-lost bow art. Infuse vast chill into the arrow and loose it at the enemy like an ice dragon piercing the heart, dealing massive damage and inflicting Frost and Stance Break.

description2.zh: 习武之人崇尚的四兽口诀之一，熟练之人可唤出玄武之力护体。短时间内增加自身防御力，并将受到的部分伤害返回给攻击者。
description2.en: One of the Four Beasts mantras revered by martial artists, those skilled can summon the power of the Black Tortoise to protect their body. Briefly increases one's Defense and reflects a portion of damage taken back to the attacker.

description2.zh: 习武之人崇尚的四兽口诀之一，若施加得当则可唤出凤凰之火遍布全身。短时间内受到伤害后会使攻击者燃烧。
description2.en: One of the Four Beast Mantras revered by martial artists, when properly invoked, it summons phoenix fire to envelop the entire body. For a short time, taking damage will ignite the attacker.

description2.zh: 在战国时时期墨家出现的传奇枪法，击退敌军，使其不敢再进半步。
description2.en: A legendary Mohist spear art from the Warring States. Knocks back enemies, halting their advance.

description2.zh: 舞动兵器，聚集内力，对敌人打出致命一击。若在出牌阶段结束后还有多余行动AP，可获得额外的移动回合，且获得连破状态。
description2.en: Brandish the weapon and focus inner power to strike the enemy with a lethal blow. If any Action Points (AP) remain after the Play Phase ends, gain an additional Movement Turn and Chain Break status.

description2.zh: 将周围敌人拉近，叠加一层【刀意】，提高8%反伤，最多叠加3层。命中后将此卡牌回收，但要消耗大量真气。
description2.en: Pull nearby enemies closer and gain 1 stack of 【Saber Will】, increasing Damage Reflect by 8% (stacks up to 3 times). Recovers this card on hit, but consumes a large amount of Qi.

description2.zh: 长剑绝学，瞬间唤出无数剑气向四周散去。
description2.en: A sword art that instantly unleashes countless Qi blades in all directions.

description2.zh: 高阶武学，造成伤害的同时施展反击架势。
description2.en: An advanced art that deals damage while entering a Counter stance.

description2.zh: 结合嗜血诀的擒拿招式。擒拿敌人后重击要害，将部分伤害转为自身生命值，并击退敌人。
description2.en: A grappling move infused with the Bloodlust Art. Grapple the enemy and strike vital points, converting part of the damage into HP and knocking back the enemy.

description.en: Named for Mount Jiankou, which it was meant to guard.

description.zh: 带有阴阳图案的华丽长袍，不知为何人所制。
description.en: An ornate robe with yin-yang motifs of unknown origin.

description.zh: 采用金丝玉缕制成的小冠，并配有独特的玉饰，由此可见此冠来历非同一般。
description.en: A small crown of gold thread and jade, fitted with unique jade ornaments, clearly of distinguished origin.

description.zh: 据传此马为霸王的坐骑乌雅马的后裔，除此之外关于此马的信息无人知晓。
description.en: Said to be a descendant of the Conqueror's mount Wuya, but beyond this, nothing is known of this horse.

name.en: Three Heroes of the Late Han

biography.zh: 童渊与李彦的师父，隐居于山林，武艺已至仙人境界。仙风道骨，鹤发童颜，身着道袍，手持拂尘，气质超凡脱俗，行踪不定，常以游方道士身份突然现身，又飘然离去。创下“天龙朝凤枪戟诀”，后传于童渊李彦二人，但因其中奥秘极其繁杂，故在二人各自参悟后，将其分别演化为“百鸟凤朝枪法”与“天龙戟法”。二人后来分别教出吕布、赵云、张绣、张任等名将。
biography.tc: 童淵與李彥的師父，隱居于山林，武藝已至仙人境界。仙風道骨，鶴發童顏，身著道袍，手持拂塵，氣質超凡脫俗，行蹤不定，常以游方道士身份突然現身，又飄然離去。創下“天龍朝鳳槍戟訣”，后傳于童淵李彥二人，但因其中奧秘極其繁雜，故在二人各自參悟后，將其分別演化為“百鳥鳳朝槍法”與“天龍戟法”。二人后來分別教出呂布、趙云、張繡、張任等名將。
biography.en: The master of Tong Yuan and Li Yan, a recluse of the mountain forests whose martial skill had reached the realm of the immortals. With the air of a Daoist sage, white-haired yet youthful of face, clad in a Daoist robe and carrying a whisk, he possessed an otherworldly bearing. His movements were unpredictable, he would appear suddenly in the guise of a wandering Daoist, then vanish just as quickly. He created the ‘Heaven Dragon and Phoenix Ascending Spear-Halberd Formula’, which he later passed down to Tong Yuan and Li Yan. However, the mysteries within were so profoundly complex that after each student had contemplated the art in his own way, they evolved it into separate disciplines: the ‘Hundred Birds Phoenix Ascending Spear’ and the ‘Heaven Dragon Halberd’ respectively. These two disciples went on to train such celebrated warriors as Lu Bu, Zhao Yun, Zhang Xiu, and Zhang Ren.
biography.jp: 童淵と李彦の師であり、山林に隠棲し、その武芸はすでに仙人の境地に達している。仙風道骨、鶴髪童顔の風貌で道服をまとい、払子を手に携え、気品は超凡脱俗。行方は定まらず、遊方道士として忽然と現れては飄然と去っていく。「天竜朝鳳槍戟訣」を創り出し、後に童淵と李彦の二人に伝えたが、その奥義があまりにも深奥かつ複雑であったため、二人がそれぞれ悟りを得た後、「百鳥鳳朝槍法」と「天竜戟法」へとそれぞれ昇華・発展させた。その後、二人はそれぞれ呂布、趙雲、張繍、張任といった名将を育て上げることとなる。
biography.kr: 동연과 이언의 스승으로, 산림에 은거하며 무예는 이미 신선의 경지에 이르렀다. 선풍도골에 학발동안의 풍채로, 도포를 입고 불진을 쥔 채 세속을 초탈한 기품을 풍긴다. 행적이 묘연하여 늘 유방도사의 신분으로 홀연히 나타났다 표연히 떠나곤 했다. 일찍이 '천룡조봉창극결'을 창안하여 훗날 동연과 이언 두 사람에게 전수했으나, 그 오의가 지극히 번잡하여 두 사람이 각자 깨달음을 얻은 끝에 이를 '백조봉조창법'과 '천룡극법'으로 각각 발전시켰다. 훗날 두 사람은 여포, 조운, 장수, 장임 등의 명장들을 길러냈다.

raw.name: 玉真子
